changelog: New voice command "select last word" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ শব্দ সিলেক্ট করো" in Bengali) and the word right before the cursor is highlighted, so you can copy just that word or dictate the correction straight over it — no need to say the word itself, which helps when the recognizer garbled it. The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 46 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
